en.faq1Question: What can I make from screenshots?
en.faq1Answer: Product demos, feature announcements, and short launch videos. The previews on this page use a fictional product to illustrate the format.
en.faq2Answer: No. Video generation requires paid access; you can browse the examples before purchasing.
en.faq3Question: Do I need to record my screen?
en.faq3Answer: Start with screenshots you already have. If you need to show an exact live action such as typing or dragging, a screen recording may be a better source.
en.faq4Question: Where can I use my video?
en.faq4Answer: Product websites, launch announcements, feature updates, and social posts are common uses. Check your chosen platform's requirements and the rights to your uploaded content.
en.faq5Question: What images and upload limits are supported?
en.faq5Answer: Upload up to 4 PNG, JPEG or WebP screenshots, up to 5 MiB each and 20 MiB in total. SVG is not supported. Use clear screenshots with readable interface text.
en.faq6Question: Can I choose the order and adjust the video?
en.faq6Answer: Arrange your screenshots, describe the direction, and choose a duration and frame in Studio. The screenshot preview shows your inputs; the AI-generated result is available after submitting a paid generation.
en.faq7Answer: Videos are 720p MP4 with no generated audio. Choose 5, 10 or 15 seconds and a 16:9, 9:16 or 1:1 frame. The homepage includes actual 10- and 15-second outputs for comparison with the source screenshot.
en.faq8Question: How are failed tasks and retries charged?
en.faq8Answer: A task reserves one paid render. Confirmed generation failures return that render; a temporary timeout keeps the task available for checking. Creating a new successful video with changed settings uses another render. A returned render is not an automatic refund of the pack payment.
en.faq9Answer: Review the privacy policy and the storage information in Studio before uploading. Do not upload personal or confidential information you are not authorized to process.
en.faq10Question: Can I use the video commercially?
en.faq10Answer: You must have the necessary rights to your screenshots and any other materials. Review the terms for the applicable usage conditions before purchasing.
en.faq11Question: How long do purchases and downloads remain available?
en.faq11Answer: Unused paid renders do not expire in the application. Input screenshots expire for new tasks after 24 hours. Generated-file availability follows the provider’s retention policy, so download important results rather than relying on indefinite storage.

zh.faq1Question: 截图可以做成什么视频？
zh.faq1Answer: 产品演示、功能公告和简短的发布视频。页面中的动效使用虚构产品，用来说明呈现形式。
zh.faq2Answer: 没有。生成视频需要付费，你可以先浏览示例，再决定是否购买。
zh.faq3Answer: 从已有截图就可以开始。如果需要精确展示输入、拖动等实时操作，录屏可能是更合适的素材。
zh.faq4Answer: 常见用途包括产品官网、发布公告、功能更新和社交帖子。请核对目标平台的要求，以及你对上传素材拥有的权利。
zh.faq5Question: 支持哪些图片，有什么上传限制？
zh.faq5Answer: 最多上传 4 张 PNG、JPEG 或 WebP 截图，单张不超过 5 MiB，总计不超过 20 MiB。不支持 SVG，请使用界面文字清晰可读的截图。
zh.faq6Question: 可以调整顺序和视频效果吗？
zh.faq6Answer: 在工作台排列截图、描述呈现方向，并选择时长与画幅。截图预览展示的是输入素材，提交付费生成后才能查看 AI 视频结果。
zh.faq7Question: 会得到什么格式的视频？
zh.faq7Answer: 输出为 720p MP4，不生成音频。可选 5、10 或 15 秒，以及 16:9、9:16、1:1 画幅。首页提供了实际生成的 10 秒与 15 秒视频，可与原始截图对照。
zh.faq8Question: 任务失败和重新制作怎样计费？
zh.faq8Answer: 任务受理时会预留一次制作次数。确认生成失败后返还次数；暂时超时的任务继续保留，供你查询。修改设置并成功生成新视频会使用另一次次数。返还次数不等于自动退回套餐付款。
zh.faq9Answer: 上传前请阅读隐私政策和工作台中的存储说明。不要上传未经授权处理的个人信息或机密内容。
zh.faq10Answer: 你需要拥有截图及其他素材所需的权利。购买前请阅读使用条款中的适用条件。
zh.faq11Question: 购买次数和下载链接多久有效？
zh.faq11Answer: 未使用的付费制作次数在应用内不过期。输入截图在 24 小时后不能再用于新任务。生成文件的可用期由供应商保留政策决定，请及时下载重要作品。
